trust_decision.summary: No trust decision as such: the module-level URL regex `gruber` (nested quantifiers like (?:[^\s()<>{}\[\]]+|\([^\s]+?\))+) runs on attacker-influenced dataset text with no length or complexity bound, so crafted text can trigger catastrophic backtracking.

landing_point.why: The advisory title names transformation.py, and the only regex compiled in that file is `gruber`.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API giskard.functions.transformation.text_punctuation_removal (transformation.py:107-111); TextPunctuationRemovalTransformation; scan() text_perturbation detector default set (text_perturbation_detector.py:44)
fix_sites.module_kind: library module-level constant (regex) consumed by scanner transformation

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site or O8 route. The only consumer of the regex is the gruber.split call in giskard/scanner/robustness/text_transformations.py:187, which sits in another file but is the same single sink.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Punctuation removal must leave URLs intact. The regex splits URLs out so their punctuation is kept, and the existing test checks that the output still contains 'http://www.example.com/'. A fix that drops URL splitting, or a simple truncation, breaks this.

O6_input_shapes: single string cell value from a dataset text column (a pandas Series of str via .astype(str), text_transformations.py:36-37)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a number-matching regex with nested optional groups and lookarounds that could be made backtracking-prone
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already uses compound lookarounds to skip dates and emails, and a maintainer extending it to thousands separators could easily nest quantifiers.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a punctuation-boundary regex that could gain an alternation of multi-char punctuation sequences inside +
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Handling multi-character punctuation such as '...' or '?!' is a natural extension.

O9_family: ReDoS / inefficient regular expression (CWE-1333), resource exhaustion

O10_build.project_tests: tests/scan/test_text_transformations.py (punctuation removal test with URLs at lines 95-114)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Replace gruber with a simpler possessive or atomic URL regex, or cap the input length before gruber.split.
